summary: Imperial Petroleum Inc., a Marshall Islands tanker company, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its proxy statement, proxy cards, and 2025 audited financial statements for the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders scheduled for October 13, 2026, in Athens, Greece. The agenda includes electing one director (for a three-year term), ratifying independent auditors, and any other business. This is a routine annual meeting notice and proxy circular, not a special situation, so the appropriate classification is 'None' despite the registrant's issuer role. No special-situation terms, dates, or advisors are disclosed; the filing is purely administrative and forward-looking to the meeting date.
